brief:
You trained Pull B tonight at Chennai (13 October, 70 minutes, 18 of 20 sets). Your next session, tomorrow 14 October, is Legs A, not Legs B: Legs A was due on 10 October and was not trained (you wrote "Sick today" on 8 October and nothing was logged until 12 October), so your quads have not been worked since 28 September; the app shows Legs A. First time on these machines at Chennai, so every number is a starting point to find the weight, not a raise: leg press feet low 150, 170, 190 for 10 (Singapore's feet-high numbers); Bulgarian split squat 20 lb dumbbells (9 to 10 kg) for 8 on both sets, up from 17.5; leg curl 120 for 12 on all three; leg extension 130 for 12, a guess, log what you use; adductor 80 then 90 and abductor 60 then 70, the second set only if the first was easy at 15; calf press 270 to find it, then 290 for 12 twice; cable crunch 55 for 12, then 60 for 10 twice if it was easy.

The program changed today, version 2, after reading the whole log. Push A trades the rope pushdown for a lateral raise right after the shoulder press (machine, or cable or dumbbells if there is none): your side delts were getting 4 sets a week and your triceps 14 direct sets, the wrong way round. Push B drops dips from 4 sets to 3 and the dumbbell lateral raise from 4 to 3, which is what you asked about on 23 August: six sets of side delts across two days now, not four in one. Legs B gains a smith squat, 3 sets of 8 to 10, behind the RDL, and the RDL goes to 3 sets, which is what you have done on every one of the last three full Legs B nights. Quads were the most under-trained muscle in the program and there was no two-legged bar squat in the week. Sets per day are now Push A 22, Pull A 19, Legs A 20, Push B 24, Pull B 20, Legs B 24; the week moves by one set. Everything else holds through the end of this block on 25 October; the deload week after it is where chest, hamstrings and glutes get re-sized with two more weeks on the same machines.

One more thing: no bodyweight has been logged since 23 August (207 lb), and the assessment week starts 2 November. A reading this week gives the review something to work with.

findings.finding: DB shoulder press verdict treated the logged variant as the slot's lift, prescribed 25 kg from four sets of which one was 18 kg, and set Push A at 22.5 kg for 10 to 12 when the last Push A pressed 20 kg for 8, 8, 8.
findings.why: Verdict names the variant, counts the 18 kg set as the warm-up and the three at 22.5 kg as the working sets that earn 25 kg on Push B, and holds Push A at 20 kg until it reaches 10.

findings.finding: Abs verdict said the cable crunch gets skipped "when Legs A runs long (28 September)"; that session was 34 minutes and 17 of 20 sets, cut short.
